payload.title: Sites never get the alexa-sync build step: the build spec is not regenerated on a version bump
payload.description: The Pilobolus deploy of #144 (Papyrus 5.65.0, build 89) ran the old build spec, with no `papyrus-app alexa-sync` line after `ampx pipeline-deploy`, so no skill was created and it had to be done by hand. Find where the Amplify build spec is generated (infra/amplify-app-shell/lib/build-specs.ts) and why a version bump does not apply it (does `papyrus-infra deploy` run in the build, and does it update the app's buildSpec?). Make it apply on the next deploy, and add a check that a deployed site's spec matches the generated one.
